contexts.text: There were twins in her womb () = that (both the good and the truth of the Natural) were conceived together. Explained.
Twins were in her womb () = both things of the Church; for twins = both, namely, good and truth.
To break with a doubled breaking () = to completely destroy.
They shall be doubled beneath, and doubled at the same time to the head thereof () = conjunction from the exterior and from the interior; for to be doubled = to be acted upon conjointly.
The city is doubled and triplicated. Described.
3 All the other viscera also are double.
2. Each (of the innumerable receptacles in the brain) is doubled...
